title: False claim
body: After a year or two, your “lifetime” subscription wont be working anymore. App itself is good.
author: Harriuks

title: Love it
body: Simplicity is why I stayed after trying other similar apps :) I love that it's not overloaded with unnecessary features, just exactly what I need - ticking the box ✅ I was about to start drawing calendars on paper, so I'm really glad I somehow ended up here :D Thanks, Kevin!
author: lbrtren

title: Simplicity is the key
body: Best app that I found so far. I was drawing habit tables by hand similar to UI on a paper, so you can imagine how happy I was to find this one. I love that it doesn’t have many useless features, it just have one - check in your daily habits. That’s why I purchased. Btw 25days streak of drinking water😜
author: Kristina515@

title: one of the best
body: i've tried a fair share of habit tracking apps and this might be the one for me. the ui is very clean and simple, easy to understand when creating and tracking habits while other apps had quite confusing user interfaces. the streak system keeps me motivated, no bugs encountered so far. this might be perfect to be honest.
author: cheerfuldeer79
